organism.common_name: Green River Eocene Armored Herring Fossil

phenomenon_scale.structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Diplomystus dentatus

paleobiology.locality: Fossil Butte Member, Green River Formation, Fossil Lake, Wyoming
paleobiology.age_note: 51.5 Ma is the catalogued Ypresian datum for this chronoseries. Smith, Carroll & Singer (2008, 10.1130/B26073.1) reconstruct the Eocene Green River lake system; this script does not re-date the beds.

predecessor.what: chromatophore cell diameter, below this tier
predecessor.change: 20 µm < λ_c/2 (92.15 µm), so a single chromatophore cannot host the unstable half-wave. The homogeneous state is the only admissible mode.

this_scale.change: Onset wavenumber k_c selected by the Schnakenberg Jacobian at D_v/D_u = 9.17. The flank expresses ocelli at λ_c.

successor.what: organ-tier wavelength, same chronospecies, sibling slot grande-diplomystus-dentatus-turing-wavelength
successor.change: λ_organ/λ_detail = 7560/184.3 > 41. The same kinetics would need diffusivities larger by that ratio squared (~1683×) to select 7.56 mm bars instead of 184.3 µm ocelli. Grande (1982) dorsal scutes, usually 22–36, sit at this coarser serial scale. There is no second Diplomystus chronospecies in the 1/1 series.

equations.activator: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + D_u laplacian(u)
equations.inhibitor: dv/dt = b - u^2 v + D_v laplacian(v)
equations.wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)

governing_model.boundary_conditions: No-flux (Neumann) on a rectangular interior flank patch. The dispersion self-test uses a periodic line so Fourier modes are eigenfunctions of the discrete Laplacian.

parameters.note: a, b, and the ratio are specific to slot 3170. D_u is solved from the k_c formula so lambda_c equals 184.3 µm. They are not the 7.56 mm sibling parameters.

empirical_claims.claim: Diplomystus dentatus is the type species; dorsal scutes usually number 22-36; maximum total length about 65 cm; Fossil Butte Member, late Early Eocene, freshwater.
empirical_claims.used_as: Organ-scale serial anatomy and locality. Not a measurement of the 184.3 µm wave.

empirical_claims.claim: Diplomystus is an ellimmichthyid, sister to Clupeiformes; Knightia is the Green River clupeoid removed from Diplomystus.
empirical_claims.used_as: Taxonomic placement in the actinopterygian series.

empirical_claims.claim: A two-species reaction-diffusion system can be stable without diffusion and unstable at a finite wavenumber k_c.
The cubic activator-inhibitor system du/dt = a - u + u^2 v, dv/dt = b - u^2 v.
empirical_claims.used_as: Kinetics. Rates were not measured on Diplomystus tissue.

empirical_claims.claim: Pomacanthus skin stripes behave as a reaction-diffusion wave.
empirical_claims.used_as: Empirical precedent that teleost integument selects a Turing wavelength. Not a Diplomystus measurement.

empirical_claims.claim: Zebrafish melanophore-xanthophore interactions generate Turing patterns.
empirical_claims.used_as: Cell-interaction precedent for a pigment wavelength. Transferred, not fitted to fossil pixels.

empirical_claims.claim: The number of pattern elements scales with domain size over the intrinsic wavelength.
empirical_claims.used_as: Why 184.3 µm and 7.56 mm are different modes of one kinetic family.

empirical_claims.claim: Radioisotopic and stratigraphic reconstruction of the Eocene Green River lake system.
empirical_claims.used_as: Framework citation for the Fossil Lake horizon. The loop age remains 51.5 Ma.

empirical_claims.claim: Laterally preserved Diplomystus dentatus from Fossil Lake, caption size 48 cm.
empirical_claims.used_as: Canonical specimen photograph and the length calibration for flank spacing.
